old_caption: The video captures a close-up view of a frying pan on a stovetop, filled with a gently simmering liquid that appears to be oil or butter. There are no visible characters or animals in the scene, and the focus remains solely on the cooking process. The video maintains a steady shot throughout, emphasizing the simmering activity within the pan.

caption: The video captures a white-interior frying pan with a reddish-copper exterior and metal rivets resting on a black stovetop, holding a shallow pool of pale yellowish liquid. Irregular patches of white foam float across the surface, one near the left of center and another along the right side. As the excerpt unfolds, these foam patches slowly deform and reshape in place, their soft outlines shifting from frame to frame rather than sliding across the pan. Small bubbles intermittently form and pop along the lower edge and within the yellowish fluid, marking a gentle simmer. The liquid itself shows faint internal swirling, with bright specular highlights drifting as the surface moves. The pan and stovetop remain largely in view, with only slight handheld drift shifting the framing over time. The dominant visible activity is this quiet, ongoing heating of the frothy liquid.
